C127.name: Bukoba Municipal Council
C127.documented: Lake Victoria floods and large waves, heavy bimodal rain, boat accidents, and cholera on the shore

area.en: Bukoba Municipal: lakeshore and Kanoni river lowlands
area.sw: Manispaa ya Bukoba: ufukwe wa ziwa na tambarare za mto Kanoni

risk.en: This area lies between steep ridges and Lake Victoria; heavy rain floods the Kanoni river lowlands and low streets, lake storms hit the port and landing sites, and the town sits in a seismically active zone.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko kati ya milima mikali na Ziwa Victoria; mvua kubwa hufurika tambarare za mto Kanoni na mitaa ya chini, dhoruba za ziwani hupiga bandari na mialo, na mji uko katika ukanda wenye matetemeko ya ardhi.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to build to earthquake-resistant standards, keep homes and goods above flood level and keep drains to the lake open. What raises the risk: adding unreinforced upper storeys, building in the Kanoni lowlands or on reclaimed lakeshore, and dumping waste in the drains. Know the open ground on the ridge away from tall walls and the lake that you will move to, go there when the Kanoni rises or the ground shakes, and stay out of damaged buildings until they are checked. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kujenga kwa viwango vinavyostahimili matetemeko, kuweka makazi na bidhaa juu ya kiwango cha mafuriko na kuweka mifereji inayoelekea ziwani wazi. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuongeza ghorofa zisizoimarishwa, kujenga kwenye tambarare za Kanoni au ufukwe uliojazwa, na kutupa taka kwenye mifereji. Fahamu uwanja wazi mlimani mbali na kuta ndefu na ziwa utakaohamia; nenda huko Kanoni inapojaa au ardhi inapotikisika, na usiingie kwenye majengo yaliyoharibika hadi yakaguliwe. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C129.name: Biharamulo District Council
C129.documented: heavy rain, floods on valleys draining to the lake, lightning, and a short dry season

area.sw: Biharamulo: misitu na vijiji vya wakulima

risk.en: This area has open woodland, farmland and game reserves on the Lake Victoria basin; frequent thunderstorms bring lightning, dry-season fires spread through grass, and wildlife raids crops near reserves.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina misitu ya wazi, mashamba na hifadhi za wanyamapori katika bonde la Ziwa Victoria; ngurumo za mara kwa mara huleta radi, moto wa kiangazi husambaa kwenye nyasi, na wanyamapori huvamia mazao karibu na hifadhi.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to fit lightning protection on schools and public buildings, keep fire breaks around homes and use community deterrents near reserves. What raises the risk: sheltering under lone trees or working in open fields when thunder starts, burning grass on windy days and farming right up to the reserve boundary. Know the nearest solid roofed building for lightning and the open cleared ground for fire that your household will move to, and go when thunder is heard or smoke is seen; do not wait for the fire to reach the village. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuweka vizuia radi shuleni na majengo ya umma, kutunza njia za kuzuia moto kuzunguka nyumba na kutumia mbinu za jamii karibu na hifadhi. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujikinga chini ya mti wa pekee au kufanya kazi uwanjani ngurumo zinapoanza, kuchoma nyasi siku za upepo na kulima hadi mpakani mwa hifadhi. Fahamu jengo imara lenye paa lililo karibu kwa ajili ya radi na uwanja wazi uliosafishwa kwa ajili ya moto ambapo kaya yako itahamia; nenda ngurumo zinaposikika au moshi unapoonekana; usisubiri moto ufike kijijini. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C126.name: Bukoba District Council
C126.documented: lake floods, large waves, boat accidents, heavy rain, and cholera

area.en: Bukoba DC: ridges and valleys near the lake
area.sw: Bukoba DC: milima na mabonde karibu na ziwa

risk.en: This area is a landscape of steep ridges and swampy valleys in an earthquake-prone zone; heavy rain causes landslides and valley flooding, and weak masonry houses are vulnerable to tremors.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina milima mikali na mabonde yenye matope katika ukanda wa matetemeko; mvua kubwa husababisha maporomoko ya ardhi na mafuriko mabondeni, na nyumba dhaifu za matofali huathirika na mitetemeko.

advice.en: For those living and building here, it helps to use reinforced, well-tied walls and roofs, keep trees on steep slopes and keep homes out of valley-bottom swamps. What raises the risk: building heavy unreinforced block walls, cutting house plots into the ridge slopes and draining swamp bottoms for houses. Agree with neighbours on a safe open place off the slope and away from the swamp, move there when cracks open or water runs muddy in long rain, and go outside to open ground when the earth shakes. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kujenga hapa, ni vyema kutumia kuta na paa zilizoimarishwa na kufungwa vizuri, kuacha miti kwenye miteremko mikali na kujenga mbali na mabwawa ya mabondeni. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga kuta nzito za matofali zisizoimarishwa, kuchonga viwanja kwenye miteremko ya milima na kukausha mabwawa ya mabondeni kwa ajili ya nyumba. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama lililo wazi nje ya mteremko na mbali na bwawa; hamieni huko nyufa zikianza kufunguka au maji ya matope yakitiririka wakati wa mvua ndefu, na tokeni nje uwanjani ardhi inapotikisika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C125.name: Karagwe District Council
C125.documented: heavy rain and landslides on the Kagera highlands, valley floods, and strong winds

area.en: Karagwe: highland ridges and banana farms
area.sw: Karagwe: milima ya nyanda za juu na mashamba ya migomba

risk.en: This area is cool highland of steep ridges where intense storms bring hail, damaging winds and landslides, flattening banana and coffee crops and blocking roads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni nyanda za juu zenye baridi na milima mikali ambako dhoruba kali huleta mvua ya mawe, upepo haribifu na maporomoko ya ardhi, yakiangusha migomba na kahawa na kuziba barabara.

advice.en: For those farming and living here, it helps to keep trees and grass strips on slopes, use windbreaks around plantations and fix roofs firmly. What raises the risk: clearing the trees on ridge tops and steep slopes, cutting new plots into the hillside and leaving roofs loosely fixed. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope with a solid roof, and move there when a storm builds, when cracks open above the house or when the slope runs muddy. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kuishi hapa, ni vyema kuacha miti na vipande vya nyasi kwenye miteremko, kutumia vizuia upepo kuzunguka mashamba na kufunga paa imara. Kinachoongeza hatari: kukata miti kwenye vilele vya milima na miteremko mikali, kuchonga viwanja vipya kwenye mlima na kuacha paa zisizofungwa imara. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko lenye paa imara, na hamieni huko dhoruba inapojengeka, nyufa zikifunguka juu ya nyumba au mteremko ukitiririsha matope. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C131.name: Kyerwa District Council
C131.documented: heavy rain, floods on the Kagera River, and lightning

area.en: Kyerwa: Kagera river border and hill farms
area.sw: Kyerwa: mpaka wa mto Kagera na mashamba ya milimani

risk.en: This area borders the Kagera river and has steep farmland; hailstorms and landslides damage crops and roads, and the river floods its swampy margins in heavy rains.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linapakana na mto Kagera na lina mashamba yenye miteremko mikali; mvua ya mawe na maporomoko huharibu mazao na barabara, na mto hufurika kingo zake zenye matope wakati wa mvua kubwa.

advice.en: For those farming and living here, it helps to protect slopes with terraces and trees, keep homes above river flood margins and fix roofs firmly against strong winds. What raises the risk: farming and building on the river's swampy margins, clearing the slopes above homes and leaving roofs unfastened. Know the higher ground away from the river and off the steep slope that you will move to, and go when the Kagera rises towards the fields or when cracks open above the house. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kuishi hapa, ni vyema kulinda miteremko kwa matuta na miti, kujenga juu ya kingo za mafuriko za mto na kufunga paa imara dhidi ya upepo mkali. Kinachoongeza hatari: kulima na kujenga kwenye kingo za matope za mto, kukata miti kwenye miteremko juu ya nyumba na kuacha paa zisizofungwa. Fahamu eneo la juu mbali na mto na nje ya mteremko mkali utakalohamia, na ondoka Kagera inapoanza kujaa kuelekea mashambani au nyufa zikifunguka juu ya nyumba. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C132.name: Missenyi District Council
C132.documented: lake-edge floods, large waves, boat accidents, and heavy rain

area.en: Missenyi: Kagera river plains and border zone
area.sw: Missenyi: tambarare za mto Kagera na ukanda wa mpakani

risk.en: This area includes the Kagera river flood plains and lies in the zone affected by the 2016 Kagera earthquake; floods cover farms and roads in wet years, and poorly built houses are at risk from tremors.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linajumuisha tambarare za mafuriko za mto Kagera na liko katika ukanda ulioathiriwa na tetemeko la ardhi la Kagera la mwaka 2016; mafuriko hufunika mashamba na barabara katika miaka ya mvua nyingi, na nyumba zisizojengwa vizuri ziko hatarini kwa mitetemeko.

advice.en: For those living and building here, it helps to use earthquake-resistant construction, build above the river flood margin and keep drainage through settlements open. What raises the risk: building unreinforced block houses, settling on the Kagera flood plain and blocking the drains with waste; for new building choose ground above the flood plain, and for houses already there know the exit and raise what you can. Know the high ground away from the river and from tall walls that you will move to, go there when the Kagera rises or the ground shakes, and do not re-enter cracked buildings until they are checked. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kujenga hapa, ni vyema kujenga kwa mbinu zinazostahimili matetemeko, kujenga juu ya kingo za mafuriko za mto na kuweka mifereji ya makazi wazi. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga nyumba za matofali zisizoimarishwa, kukaa kwenye tambarare za mafuriko za Kagera na kuziba mifereji kwa taka; kwa ujenzi mpya chagueni ardhi juu ya tambarare ya mafuriko, na kwa nyumba zilizopo tayari fahamu njia ya kutokea na inueni mnachoweza. Fahamu eneo la juu mbali na mto na kuta ndefu utakalohamia; nenda huko Kagera inapojaa au ardhi inapotikisika, na usiingie tena kwenye majengo yenye nyufa hadi yakaguliwe. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C128.name: Muleba District Council
C128.documented: heavy rain, lake floods, boat accidents, and landslides on the inland hills

area.en: Muleba: lake islands and landing sites
area.sw: Muleba: visiwa vya ziwa na mialo

risk.en: This area includes many Lake Victoria islands and landing sites where sudden storms capsize boats, lightning strikes on open water, and crowded fishing camps face cholera outbreaks.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linajumuisha visiwa vingi vya Ziwa Victoria na mialo ambapo dhoruba za ghafla hupindua mitumbwi, radi hupiga majini, na kambi za wavuvi zenye msongamano hukumbwa na milipuko ya kipindupindu.

advice.en: For those fishing and living here, it helps to wear life jackets, keep boats in good repair, return to shore before storms build and keep safe water and latrines at landing sites. What raises the risk: going out in overloaded or unlit boats, fishing on when clouds build over the lake, and drinking untreated lake water at crowded camps. Know the sheltered bay or landing you will run to when a storm builds, agree it with your crew, and move sick people to the health post at the first sign of watery diarrhoea; do not wait for more cases. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaovua na kuishi hapa, ni vyema kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa, kutunza vyombo viwe imara, kurudi ufukweni kabla dhoruba haijaanza na kuhakikisha mialo ina maji safi na vyoo. Kinachoongeza hatari: kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa kupita kiasi au visivyo na taa, kuendelea kuvua mawingu yanapojengeka juu ya ziwa, na kunywa maji ya ziwa yasiyotibiwa kwenye kambi zenye msongamano. Fahamu ghuba au mwalo uliokingwa utakaokimbilia dhoruba inapojengeka, kubaliana nao na wenzako wa chombo, na peleka wagonjwa kituo cha afya dalili ya kwanza ya kuharisha maji; usisubiri wagonjwa wengi. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C130.name: Ngara District Council
C130.documented: heavy rain, floods on the Ruvubu and Kagera, and strong winds on the highlands

area.en: Ngara: steep hills and the Rusumo border
area.sw: Ngara: milima mikali na mpaka wa Rusumo

risk.en: This area is hilly border country where heavy rain causes landslides and road washouts, and cross-border movement at Rusumo raises the risk of disease outbreaks.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni nchi ya milima mpakani ambako mvua kubwa husababisha maporomoko ya ardhi na barabara kusombwa, na mwingiliano wa watu mpakani Rusumo huongeza hatari ya milipuko ya magonjwa.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep slopes planted, keep roadside drains clear and maintain good hygiene and vaccination at border markets. What raises the risk: cutting plots into the hillsides, blocking the roadside drains with waste and ignoring early cases of fever or diarrhoea at the border markets. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope, move there when cracks open or the slope runs muddy in heavy rain, and report any cluster of sickness to the health post the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko, kuweka mifereji ya kando ya barabara wazi na kudumisha usafi na chanjo kwenye masoko ya mpakani. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchonga viwanja kwenye miteremko ya milima, kuziba mifereji ya kando ya barabara kwa taka na kupuuza wagonjwa wa mwanzo wa homa au kuharisha kwenye masoko ya mpakani. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko; hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka au mteremko ukitiririsha matope wakati wa mvua kubwa, na ripoti kundi lolote la wagonjwa kituo cha afya siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
